phase3_findings.description: The free-text smuggling guard `_REVIEW_COVERAGE_ANY_MARKER_RE` was widened in this PR to also screen `review-roster` markers, but no test drives a forged `review-roster` marker through a free-text field (--note / --checkpoint text / rationale). `_review_roster_members` reads roster rows via the same tail-anchored `_review_coverage_marker_rows` path used for coverage records, so a --note ending in a roster marker could be read back as a genuine roster member (e.g. forging requesting-code-review=dispatched), letting a narrow shadow satisfy roster=complete — the exact self-report the feature prevents. The `|review-roster` alternation is the sole defense and if dropped every current test still passes. The existing free-text guard loop (test lines ~12036-12054) drives only review-coverage / review-coverage-disposition markers; add a case planting `workpad._review_roster_marker(...)` into a --note and asserting the write is refused with 'reserved review-coverage'.
